title: Potential of LLM-Generated Lifestyle Adjustment Recommendations Based on Multimodal Data

contributions.purpose: 探索 LLM 从多模态数据生成生活方式建议的可行性
contributions.mechanism: 为虚构人物 Alice 模拟 7 天多模态时间序列(主观情绪/压力/生产力 + 可穿戴 HRV/步数/睡眠等),结构化 prompt 引导 LLM 分析并产出带依据的建议
contributions.evaluation: 定性:LLM 产出 5 条与数据模式对应的安全建议;表内为分组均值(如高压组步数4167 vs 低压8400)
contributions.source_quote: we simulate realistic multimodal time-series data for a prototypical remote worker, design a natural language prompt to elicit recommendations from an LLM.

contributions.purpose: 提出可复用的 generate-then-evaluate 双LLM流水线
contributions.mechanism: 独立第二个 LLM 从 safety/relevance/feasibility 三维评估生成的建议
contributions.evaluation: 定性:所有建议均被评为 safe/grounded/feasible(Table 3),但评估者与生成者同一模型家族
contributions.source_quote: the dual-LLM pipeline—consisting of a generator model that produces candidate recommendations and an evaluator model that rates their safety, feasibility, and contextual fit—could be generalized as a reusable research workflow.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Beyond digital health, analogous "generate-then-evaluate" pipelines may support tasks in education, computational creativity, or human–computer interaction research.

notes: reject/desk。数据红旗+循环自证:(1) 全部数据为模拟(虚构人物 Alice 7天),Table1/2 分组均值来自自造数据;(2) 评估用的第二个 LLM 与生成器"same model family",作者自认可能 replicate/reinforce 生成器假设而非独立评估——自证闭环。数据红旗(AI 自我暴露):Reproducibility Statement 直接贴出用来写整篇论文的元 prompt("You are a researcher. Write a scientific paper... approximately 24,000 characters... Topic:..."),坐实论文由模板 prompt 一键生成。非实证适配:无统计检验(checklist Q7=NA),evaluation 定性。checklist AI 披露:Analysis=D(AI 产出主要建议,人类原创分析极少)、Writing=C。贡献由 abstract+conclusion 归纳两条(均为 method 性质)。
